scope.drawCoverageSource: not measured for this racing-line path
scope.engineTrace: not run by this builder; the path is a geometric raster result, not a driven lap
scope.note: a data layout, not an e1-drive integration: no gate mesh, no race director, no lap timing, no car simulated. The path is the retail AI racing line projected onto collision, not a retail start line.

source.probe: probes/map-laps-aid (retail AI racing line projected onto collision)

slice.contentHashSource: the map-batch package records no canonical content hash for collision.json; its committed file pin is used
slice.note: the collision slice document; the map-batch manifest is not pinned here because it pins map-registry.js, which pins this package

render.contentHashSource: the map-batch package records no canonical content hash for draws.json; its committed file pin is used

raster.notInRaster: the committed collision buffer ships 1 static triangle-mesh shapes; 0 excluded shapes () are not in the buffer and are not in the raster
raster.source: P48 passable raster built from the committed collision.positions.f32.bin / collision.indices.u32.bin triangle buffer

sliceCollision.note: the same 12706 triangles as the raster; the buffer is the committed collision surface

aid.projectionNote: the spawn/finish projections are the racing-line points nearest the committed poses; the path projections include the lateral detour offset
aid.selectionRule: closed non-logic route (ROUTE_LOOPED without ROUTE_LOGIC_ZONE) at least 300 m long whose racing line passes nearest the committed spawn; ties go to the longer route then the lower route index
aid.projectionRule: the racing line is used unchanged when its car half-width band is passable; otherwise a station moves along its own normal to a band-clear position inside the declared +/-12 m respawn band (0.25 m steps) by a deterministic second-order dynamic program; consecutive detour points are at most 0.5 m apart and the line returns to the racing line when it becomes clear
aid.detourRule: bounded lateral detour: a station whose racing point is not car-half-width clear moves along its own normal to the nearest continuous band-clear position inside the declared +/-12 m respawn band; the detour is continuous (<= 0.5 m between consecutive samples) and returns to the racing line when the racing point becomes clear; every detour point is validated with the line's own local tangent
